title: Clarify lifecycle evidence and Tauri shutdown
summary: Require backend shutdown acknowledgement before Tauri force-close can terminate its child tree.
reason: Prevent transport failures from becoming authorization to kill active backend work.
behavior_before: A confirmed native close could terminate a live backend after unavailable shutdown transport.
behavior_after: Tauri retains an unacknowledged backend and blocks shell close; evidence docs/inventory include recovery state.
manual_validation: Tauri check/build and targeted shutdown tests passed.
rollback_plan: Revert Rust close behavior only with a documented operator decision on abandoned backend handling.
notes: Tauri now retains an unacknowledged backend and route inventory exposes recovery state.
